description: This Java class 'DeviceState' manages device profile states, alarm states, and processes telemetry and attribute updates within the Thingsboard rule engine. It handles dynamic data fetching, alarm processing, and state persistence for device monitoring.

classes.name: DeviceState
classes.description: Manages device profile state, alarm states, and processes telemetry and attribute updates within the Thingsboard rule engine.

methods.name: updateProfile
methods.description: Updates the device profile, refreshes latest values if needed, and synchronizes alarm states.

methods.name: harvestAlarms
methods.description: Processes and updates alarm states, optionally persisting changes.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, updates device state, and triggers alarm processing.

methods.name: processDeviceActivityEvent
methods.description: Processes device activity or inactivity events.

methods.name: processAlarmClearNotification
methods.description: Handles alarm clear notifications.

methods.name: processAlarmAckNotification
methods.description: Handles alarm acknowledgment notifications.

methods.name: processAlarmDeleteNotification
methods.description: Handles alarm delete notifications.

methods.name: processAttributesUpdateNotification
methods.description: Processes attribute update notifications.

methods.name: processAttributesDeleteNotification
methods.description: Processes attribute delete notifications.

methods.name: processAttributesUpdateRequest
methods.description: Processes attribute update requests.

methods.name: processTelemetryRequest
methods.description: Processes telemetry data requests.

methods.name: processTelemetryUpdatedNotification
methods.description: Processes telemetry update notifications.

methods.name: processTelemetryUpdate
methods.description: Handles telemetry data updates and alarm processing.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges telemetry or attribute data into the current data snapshot.

methods.name: getKeyTypeFromScope
methods.description: Converts scope string to EntityKeyType enum.

methods.name: fetchLatestValues
methods.description: Fetches latest telemetry and attribute values for the device.

methods.name: addEntityKeysToSnapshot
methods.description: Adds entity key data to the snapshot from device attributes and timeseries.

methods.name: addToSnapshot
methods.description: Adds attribute data to the snapshot.

methods.name: toEntityValue
methods.description: Converts KvEntry to EntityKeyValue.

methods.name: getProfileId
methods.description: Returns the device profile ID.

methods.name: getOrInitPersistedAlarmState
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes persisted alarm state for a given alarm.
